# WordPress FAQ

> WordPress FAQ turns real Reddit discussions into concise, community-verified answers on plugins, themes, hosting, compatibility and version updates.. Every page summarises real Reddit community discussions to give concise, sourced answers about WordPress plugin and theme compatibility, performance, and setup.

## Purpose

This site aggregates community knowledge about WordPress. Answers reflect real-world experience shared on Reddit, not vendor marketing. Each page includes a verdict, confidence level, source count, and FAQ pairs.
